div.head: Abt 17
div.ab: Gif man in mannes tún ærest geirneþ, VI scillingum gebete;
Gif man in mannes tún ærest geirneþ, VI scillingum gebete.
If a person breaks [as the] first into someone’s dwelling, let him pay with 6 shillings.
If a man is the first to make [forcible] entry into another man’s premises, he shall pay 6 shillings compensation.
If a man is the first to force his way into a man’s homestead, he is to pay six shillings compensation; he who enters next, three shillings; afterwards each [is to pay] a shilling.
Wenn einer in jemandes Hofbezirk [als] erst[er] eindringt, büsse er [diesem] mit 6 Schillingen;
If someone forces his way first into a person’s court-precinct, let him pay [him] 6 shillings;
div.note: Whitelock translates Abt 17 as one clause, which the sheet divides into rows 17, 17[a], 17[b]; her translation of the whole is given here, in the first row.
